_about: Hand-written test notes for the Brute's effects workbook (tools/gh_testsheet.py). turns: the test hand in play order. states: what Gloomhaven shows for each animator state the cards play. status: what the last in-game run found per state (shown in the sheet so only the open checks need playing). actions: effects that are not on a card.

turns.order: Bottom first: move 2 toward the enemies, shield up, then throw.
turns.setup: An enemy within 3 hexes after the move.

turns.order: Bottom first: move 4 next to as many enemies as you can, stun them, then the sweep.
turns.setup: At least one adjacent enemy after the move.

turns.order: Top first: the swing, then move 3 to another enemy and push it.
Bottom first: move 3 next to an enemy, the attack bonus, then the bash.
Bottom first: heal yourself (works at full health), then move 1 and loot.
turns.setup: A coin within 2 hexes after the move.

states.Attack: Plain one-handed sword swing with the Brute's standard swing sound and the weapon impact; the hit flash on the target.
states.Attack_AOE_Cone: Heavy two-handed overhead swing, slower and bigger than the plain one. No particle effect of its own. The deep Overwhelming Assault swing sound, then the impact and the hit flash.
states.Attack_AOE_Radial: Radial ground slam: a shock wave spreads from his feet about 1.4 s in, then a column of earth and dust erupts on each hex of the area about 1.6 s in (brown and grey, never pink), with the earthquake rumble.
states.RangedAttack: Throw: he reaches to his right hip and a glint flashes on his right hand as the dagger is drawn, about 1 s in. Then the throw with a whoosh, a trail streaking to the target, and the hit flash.
states.PowerUp: Power-up cast: arms-raised pose, a light 'positive' sparkle bursts around him about 0.5 s in, with the cast-positive sound.
states.Persistent Buff: Shield power-up: he braces behind the shield (a different pose from the plain cast). A golden 'gain' sparkle rises around him from the start, with one of four metallic shield sounds, picked at random each time.
states.Heal: Heal cast: the cast pose, a green heal sparkle around him about 0.5 s in, with the heal sound (no grunt).
states.TargetedShout: Targeted roar: he plants his feet and roars at the target; a shout ring spreads on the ground at his feet about 1 s in, with the shout-attack sound. Then the push slides the target.
states.RadialShout: Radial roar: head thrown back, roaring all round. A shout ring at his feet about 1.2 s in and a marker on each adjacent enemy's hex about 1.3 s in, with the radial-shout sound.
states.Loot: Loot: he stoops and scoops (the Brute's own loot clip). No effect or sound of his own; the coin's pickup effect and sound are the game's.
states.Jump: A jump move: he leaps hex to hex (take-off, flight, landing), attacking each enemy he passes over with the plain swing.

actions.name: Movement
actions.expected: Run cycle with heavy footstep sounds and a dust puff at each footfall.

actions.name: Item use
actions.expected: He raises the item in his right hand (a small glow on the hand about 1.4 s in), then a burst at his feet as it takes effect about 3 s in, with the item-use sound (no grunt).

actions.name: Taking a hit
actions.expected: Hit reaction with one of two grunts, picked at random.

actions.name: Being pushed or pulled
actions.how: An enemy push or pull, if the scenario has one.
actions.expected: He slides to the new hex with a dust trail under his feet and the hit grunt.

actions.name: Exhaustion
actions.expected: He falls with the exhausted groan, then the game's dissolve.

actions.name: Scenario end
actions.expected: Victory pose: the radial roar with its shout ring at his feet and the radial-shout sound.
